The plan comment's Next line names the review's other options
## Today

When a plan waits for its review, the status comment's `Next:` line ends with the review's other options, such as "Its other option: `recipe`." (`nextLines`' `plan_review` case in `src/engine/status-comment.ts`). The plan comment's `Next:` line (`src/engine/plan-comment.ts`) stops at `planNextStep`, so the same plan reads differently in the two comments. `npm run demo -- ladder` shows both in its first step.

## What to build

- [ ] The plan comment's `Next:` line names the review's other options as the status comment's does, with the same words, using one shared piece of code.
- [ ] A plan with no other option reads as it does today.

**See it:** the first step of `npm run demo -- ladder` shows the same `Next:` line in both comments. Update what the demo tests pin.

For the self-brew trial (#374): small on purpose. No new ADR unless the change needs one.
